question: Four point charges are placed at the vertices of a square of side $a$. The charges are $+q, -q, +q, -q$ in clockwise order starting from the top-left vertex. What is the work done by an external agent to swap the positions of the top-left charge ($+q$) with the adjacent top-right charge ($-q$)?
